remarks: Set on a beautifully landscaped acre along one of Darien's most coveted residential lanes, 10 Queens Lane is a timeless 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath Colonial offering the space, character, and setting that make it truly special. With 3,694 square feet of living space, this home strikes the perfect balance between classic New England charm and everyday comfort. The gracious layout features generously sized rooms throughout, ideal for both relaxed family living and easy entertaining. The main level flows effortlessly from formal to casual spaces, while four spacious bedrooms upstairs offer the room to grow. There is also potential to expand the second floor over the family room and update the finishes to reflect your own personal style. The expansive one-acre lot provides exceptional privacy with ample room for outdoor play, or simply enjoying the tranquil surroundings. Located just off Old Kings Highway South, this sought-after address puts you minutes from the Darien train station, Downtown Corbin district, library, top-rated schools, and all that this beloved shoreline community has to offer, including nearby beaches and Great Island. Whether you are commuting to the city or settling into the rhythms of coastal Connecticut living, don't miss this home!
